notes.title: 《Dark Lord Leona》Offer up your male essence！！！
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3464630/_/?beta=0
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/9deef9da51e3f01abd7d7fe57d911cd3686e43a0.png[/img]

[b]【Story】[/b]

666 years after the extermination of the demon race, the Demon King's daughter, Leona, awakens and resolves to execute the "Demon Instrumentality". This plan involves seeking powerful genes across various nations, engaging in reproduction, and giving birth to potent hybrid offspring to dominate these nations, ultimately spreading demon influence across the world.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/c9a94f9f75c7b53d2e688129ff000c2370a1f8a1.png[/img]

[b]【Info】[/b]

Dark Lord Leona is a fast-paced card strategy game where you strategize and combine your playstyle each turn to crush your enemies.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/a61e17d07d734e4c8a18d445e55927e82b5dc5c5.png[/img]

[b]【Feature】[/b]
[list]
[*] The game features 10 costumes that can be switched, each with different skills.
[*] Card Rogue, constantly switching and building different playstyles to battle enemies.
[*] 12 sets of dynamic CGs.
[*] 22 talent skills.
[/list]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/4799d838f68f60070472ebeeeab0a3212fbcff68.png[/img]

notes.title: 《Stranger Maidens Please Protect Me!》Adventure with Stranger Maidens, fight together, and explore intimate connections！😏🔥
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3028830/_/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/c816ebbb2c8e7e75915d6a5fa180e6baa28cc1d0.png[/img]

[h1][b]【Game System】[/b][/h1]
Not like your typical Roguelike Survivor, this game focuses on an innovative Squad Based Combat System. Adept to various challenges with a diverse cast of Stranger Maidens, build your ultimate team to eliminate your foes.  

Whether you want to minmax your way to success, or you just want to hangout with your favourite girl, “Stranger Maidens” will provide you with a satisfying experience.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/4d54c5afb7f419c1fe83456b4c2d98925d3694d2.gif[/img]

[h1][b]【Story】[/b][/h1]
You play as Joey, a loser who was traumatised by the loss of his father. One day you received a mysterious artefact left by your father, and you are determined to go on an adventure to find out what happened to him.

In your journey you will encounter a variety of beautiful yet mysterious Strangers Maidens, each with their own story to tell. Combining their combat prowess and the strange power of the artefact, you come closer to the truth with every step…

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/2ec68afb43037392d04cab60e9e06b375197593c.png[/img]

[h1][b]【Feature】[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Tactical Squad Based Combat System provides many possibilities in every battle.
[*] Powerful upgrades await your discovery.
[*] Traditional RPG narration style, you get stories both in and out of combat.
[*] 19 uniquely designed story stages, no more repetitive gameplay.
[*] 6 Stranger Maidens each with their own story and unique charm.
[*] All sex scenes are fully hand drawn and fully animated.
[/list]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/bc0de0566e0d52261a246565beaefc06adbda1c1.png[/img]

notes.title: "Endless Tentacle Cave" A New Experience with Tentacles and Latex Suits
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/65150fc4fe30f17ebdf525ff21d5eb543e46d902.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2988290

[b][h2]Game Plot[/h2][/b]
A young girl with the ability to control monsters inadvertently falls into a trap set by tentacles. Her ability fails, and her body is modified, rendering her completely defenseless. But the only thing on the minds of these monsters is "desire"! As long as I drain all the monsters I encounter, I can escape! And so, the girl's journey of escape begins.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/ea9c0b2cb1f0d4e2ab4b887d1192f2be21df1730.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]Features[/h2][/b]
Demons, tentacle clothing, parasites, or even former allies!
There are about 50 types of enemies.
Over 40 animated battle sequences.
In addition to common CG, each type of enemy also has exclusive CG.
Total CG count: 120+ (no variations).
Includes a built-in 19-page story comic for preview anytime.

Embark on this fantastical journey driven solely by desire!
